description: Canonical keyed work registry. The tasks object is keyed by immutable internal task IDs; Markdown is a human-readable index only.

key_value_contract.key: Immutable internal task ID (T-###); never a thesis citation or research identifier.
key_value_contract.value: One task record containing type, title, status, priority, targets, dependencies, next_action, blockers and completion_rule.
key_value_contract.authority: The thesis and enduring research documents remain authoritative for substantive arguments/evidence; PROJECT_STATE is authoritative for current project position; WORKPLAN for roadmap; WORK_LOG for chronology.
